page.overview:
What is Adventure Phantom Chica?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Phantom Chica is almost identical to her core series counterpart, except obviously smaller. Her eyes are just one big white dot with a single white ring around it. Her cupcake is noticeably gone, like her core series character.

Phantom Chica can be useful to use. Her Toxic Bite can damage as well as poisoning an enemy and others nearby. Sludge can lower all enemies' speed so they slowly attack. Lastly, Unscrew is useful against single targets as the ones can have a 1/3 chance to destroy an enemy, regardless of health.
